price_field_note: USA List = the wholesale/dealer price (what Benson pays). The Marquis price book does not publish a separate MSRP/retail column. msrp left null. Marquis is a Kingsman subsidiary; the price book is published on a Marquis-branded sheet but shares the same Rev 020426 effective date and uses many of the same SKU prefixes (FDV200S, FDV350, FDV451, IDV24/26/34/44, ZCV34/39/42, ZCVRB3622, ZCV3622, HBZDV3624/3628/4224/4228/4736). Marquis-unique SKUs use the MQ prefix and cover the Enclave linear/peninsula series, Bentley 48, Bentley ST, Atrium (MCVP42), Aurora outdoor, Fire Pits, and Vantage Bay (MQFDV453).

rockford_field_rule_note: Rockford City requires IPI (Intermittent Pilot Ignition) on most direct-vent installs — standing-pilot millivolt models may not pass inspection in city limits. In this price book ignition mix across the 177 appliance models is 63 millivolt SKUs vs 114 IPI SKUs (IPI PF1 and PF2 combined). The Enclave linear/peninsula series (MQVL/MQVLBG/MQZCVBG/MQVLST) and the new Enclave 61/62 are IPI-PF2-only. Outdoor models (Aurora, Fire Pits) and most Bentley/Solace/Capri/Capella/Solara/Sentinel/Titan/Vantage units offer both millivolt and IPI variants — quote the -NE/-LPE/-NE2/-LPE2 SKUs for Rockford addresses.
